group.label: General
group.comment: Deals are ordinary Catalog Price Rules with a "Deal Display" label + type set on the rule. The rule owns the conditions, actions (discount), schedule and scope; this module surfaces the labelled ones on the storefront. When disabled the deals query returns empty and no product deal badge is resolved.

field.label: Maximum Products on the Deals Page
field.comment: Caps how many products the deals query returns.

group.label: First-Order Deal (Customer Group Automation)
group.comment: Makes a First Order deal type actually track first-time customers. New registrations are placed in a dedicated customer group (any channel: storefront, GraphQL, social login); once they place their first order they are moved back to the default group. Scope a Catalog Price Rule to the group below and label it as a First Order deal, and its badge/price will show only until the customer's first order. Note: guests can't be in a group, so this targets shoppers who register before ordering.

field.label: First-Order Customer Group
field.comment: New customers are placed here. Scope your first-order Catalog Price Rule to this group. Use its own group (not General), and give it the same tax class as General.

field.label: Group After First Order
field.comment: Customers are moved to this group once they place their first order (usually General).

field.label: Default Registration Group
field.comment: Only registrations with this (or no) group are auto-assigned, so an explicit group such as Wholesale is never overridden. Usually General.
